description: Story Phase 8 (the Lost Fart; the Grand Nap) has begun: a day and a half in the hold, the Great Sharkstorm still on the roof.

Story Phase 8: chapter 43 has begun.
Chapter 43: asked the Grand Stenchmaster whether he needs to fart ('I don't know.').
Chapter 43: Squawks buttoned into the captain's coat for the false alarm.
Chapter 43: everyone at the stairs; a false alarm. No rowboat ('Bad planning').
The false alarm: the Grand Stenchmaster's stomach said 'Oh. Ohhhh.', everybody ran for the stairs, and nothing happened. Not a release. (The fart is sneaky.)

The Grand Stenchmaster Sash is called the FART SASH by everybody but him (he says STENCHMASTER SASH, every time). Nobody volunteered to hold it.

Story Phase 8: chapter 51 has begun.
Lights out in the barracks (chapter 51 on): night.
Chapter 51: in the bunk; the Grand Bedtime Story begins.
The Grand Bedtime Story has been told in full (Reekhollow, seven chambers, the Golden Bottle of Wind, Sir Garrick the First, the onion). Garrick's claims, not history. Moral: hold the sash.
Story Phase 8: chapter 52 has begun.
The Grand Stenchmaster is in his hammock over the captain's bunk, in full ceremonial attire.
Chapter 52: the Suit's trapped puffs (FWOoF) on the captain. Bad bunk.
Story Phase 8: chapter 53 has begun.
The Grand Crown came down in the night (the cutlery incident).
The Grand Crown fell on the captain in the night (cutlery; nobody hurt) and is banned from the hammock: it lives in a crate at night. He may still wear it awake.
Chapter 53: back in the bunk after the crown.
Story Phase 8: chapter 54 has begun.
The captain has the sash, like evidence in a courtroom.
Chapter 54: woke Pete with the evidence.
Chapter 54: woke Gristle with the evidence.
Chapter 54: woke Bob with the evidence.
The sash's true origin (Garrick, in his sleep): bought LAST WEEK from a sketchy discount shop, seventy per cent off, cash only, no refunds, no receipt. Never ancient.
The crew are invested in The Frog Tax Man now (Franklin's capital gains, his basis, the auditor), more than in the storm, at three in the morning.
Story Phase 8 is complete: the night of the Grand Nap. Nobody slept. NO ADVENTURE.
Story Phase 8: chapter 48 has begun.
The Grand Stenchmaster stood in front of the old quarters' door, embarrassed: the contents may have stayed.
Pete cracked the old quarters' door: the fart took residence. Centuries.
The old sleeping quarters are CONDEMNED for good: permanent embedded contamination from the second release (not the Dead Center, which moved on). The sign is nailed up. Nobody goes in.
Story Phase 8: chapter 49 has begun.
The Grand Decree: the lower hull shall be the barracks; the highest hammock his; quiet hours after the Grand Bedtime Story.
Story Phase 8: chapter 50 has begun.
Chapter 50: the hammocks are slung.
Chapter 50: a sailcloth screen over the captain's corner.
Chapter 50: the clutter shifted; there's floor.
Squawks has his own cradle beside the captain's bunk. Good spot.
Chapter 50: helped Pete rig a bunk.
Chapter 50: helped Bob rig a bunk.
Chapter 50: helped Gristle rig a bunk.
Chapter 50: helped Jim rig a bunk.
The Grand Stenchmaster sleeps in the highest hammock (rank; altitude), directly over the captain's bunk.
The lower hull (the cargo hold) is the crew's barracks now, by Grand Decree: hammocks, bunks, a pantry, the Mark II. Their common room. Home, apparently.
Story Phase 8: chapter 45 has begun.
Bob is wearing the costume trunk's sun-helmet: PROFESSOR BARNACLE BOB (he wants no part of it).
The Grand Stenchmaster's Grand Crown exists: fake gold, bottle caps, painted onions, Jim's cutlery, the bilge pump's handle, a little saucepan on top. A stink-cloud-and-onion crest. No letters.
THE GRAND EXPEDITION FOR THE LOST FART has been proposed (Garrick's adventure game; the crew call it the Lost Fart nonsense). Everything in it is Garrick making things up.

Chapter 46: saw what the 'Electric Frog Oracle' landmark really is.
Chapter 46: saw what the 'Bottomless Ravine' landmark really is.
Chapter 46: the captain handed Squawks to Gristle and let him have it.
Story Phase 8: chapter 47 has begun.
The Grand Nap was banned (until he knows whether he's about to kill everyone).
Told where Story Phase 8 starts (the crate next to Squawks), once, on coming into the hold after Phase 7.
